claims.claim_text: North Star's vision of democratic socialism has democracy at its core, and North Star favors deepening and extending democracy.
North Star believes democracy requires a foundation in the principles of liberty and equality.
North Star believes democracy requires protection from the influence of concentrated economic power.
North Star believes in the democratization of the economy in service of the public good and the general welfare.
North Star believes in the democratization of society and in an end to all forms of bigotry, discrimination and oppression.
North Star believes the United States must adopt a democratic socialist foreign policy in world affairs.
North Star is opposed to militarism and imperialism.
